topics.topic: How EffectApproval objects transition when they become stale/inapplicable (run end or request digest change before send)
questions: At run end, do still-open approvals change status (e.g., to expired/void), or remain `requested`/`approved` but become inert by rule?
If a previously approved effect cannot be sent because the built request changed, what model transition occurs for the old approval and what new approval object is created?

topics.topic: How `purpose` is sourced and whether it is required when first authoring/composition implicitly creates a Slot or Flow
questions: When a new slot or flow is implicitly created by first version authoring, where does `purpose` come from, and is creation allowed without it?
When the first contract creates a slot, is `purpose` required in that author request, optional, or system-filled?
When first composition creates a flow, how is `purpose` set?

topics.topic: What defines ManifestOperation identity (digest only vs including selected-instance facts)
questions: Is ManifestOperation identity only the operation capability record digest, or does it also include selected-instance facts that can change without a digest change?

topics.topic: What the EffectApproval preview must include for file inputs to qualify as the exact owner-reviewed input
questions: For file inputs, what must the approval preview contain to count as the "exact input" shown to the owner?

topics.topic: When a proven read-only flow version becomes active (automatic on compose/prove vs explicit activate action)
questions: When exactly is a proven read-only flow version activated: automatically at successful compose/prove, or only when an explicit activate action is called?

topics.topic: Whether an EffectAttempt is created (and with what status) when the owner refuses before any send
questions: When the owner refuses before any send, is an EffectAttempt record created, and if so with which status?

topics.topic: Whether service instance selection is mandatory or some services may intentionally have no selected instance
questions: Is instance selection mandatory for every service, or can some services intentionally have no selected instance?
